fee_notes: Single unit Standard Offering: $59,000. Single unit Reduced Initial Fee: $29,500. Multi-unit fees range from $59,000 (two-pack reduced) to $153,000 (three-pack standard). Additional senior territory fee: $2.00 per senior. Fees are uniformly imposed and non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: Single Unit Franchise Standard Offering: $59,000. Reduced Initial Fee Offering: $29,500. Multi-Unit Development Standard Offering two units: $108,500 ($59,000 + $49,500); three units: $153,000 ($59,000 + $49,500 + $44,500).
